Relaxation and adventure await at our 'Star of the Sea' in beautiful Magnolia Cottages by the Sea at Seacrest Beach 30A; offering resort accommodations for up to 10 guests in 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms.



Beach Access:

The Magnolia Cottages by the Sea resort community features private deeded beach access right across 30A, approximately .2 miles from this home



Community Pool:

Magnolia Cottages by the Sea offers a seasonally heated community pool, minutes from the home.



Magnolia Cottages by the Sea is a charming Florida cottage resort community in Seacrest Beach, located within minutes of Seaside and Rosemary Beach. The small resort community features a natural, secluded atmosphere and offers a seasonally heated community pool as well as deeded beach access right across 30A.



Updated with a rejuvenating coastal ambiance, this two-story Florida cottage offers the seclusion and tranquility of a perfect coastal getaway. It’s prime location just off scenic Highway 30A is just minutes from the sugar-white Seacrest beaches, Camp Creek Golf Club, as well as all the shopping, entertainment and dining options 30A has to offer.



Vaulted wood ceilings, hardwood floors, and soft coastal tones create a bright, welcoming atmosphere throughout this thoughtfully designed home. The second floor features an open-concept living space with comfortable seating, a large flat-screen TV, and plenty of natural light. The fully equipped kitchen offers granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample prep space, while the dining area provides seating for 6, plus additional seating for 4 at the breakfast bar—perfect for gathering after a day at the beach.



All sleeping accommodations are conveniently located on the first floor, offering privacy and ease for every guest. The primary suite features a King bed and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower. A second guest bedroom offers a Queen bed with its own private bathroom. At the end of the hall, the bunk room is ideal for kids or groups, featuring one Full-over-Full bunk and two Twin-over-Twin bunks, along with a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo.



With the kitchen, living area, and a half bath located upstairs, this home is perfectly set up for relaxing together while still offering quiet, comfortable sleeping quarters below—making it an ideal coastal retreat for families and groups alike.



Seacrest Beach is known for having the highest sand dunes on 30A and is home to Camp Creek Lake, an undisturbed rare dune lake surrounded by walking trails. Located just minutes from the famous Seaside and Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach is a perfect spot to enjoy the best that 30A has to offer.



30A is a scenic stretch of highway down Florida’s beautiful gulf coast between Destin and Panama City Beach. The highway connects the coastal villages of South Walton through the undisturbed beauty of rare dune lakes, sugar white sand, and emerald blue waters indigenous to the area. Each village has its own unique characteristics that paint a fairy tale like scene against some of the country's most beautiful beaches. Come live the 30A life and experience the beach the way it was meant to be, where Southern Charm meets Bohemian lifestyle and unforgettable vacation memories are created.



Enjoy our 6 Adult Bikes to cruise down 30A in Style!

Quick rides to Inlet beach, Rosemary, Seacrest Beach and more!!



This home is on our Resort Linen and Terry Package with guaranteed fresh linen and terry placed every turn!

Please note, this is a non-smoking property. Smoking is prohibited on the premises including patios and balconies.

Nearby restaurants to 'Star of the Sea' at Magnolia Cottages by the Sea include The Acme Ice House, Crabby Steve's, La Cocina Mexican Grill & Bar, Seacrest Sundries, Shrimp Whiskers as well as many more in the nearby Seaside and Rosemary Beach!
